Line Station Mise En Place — Sauté & Grill:
- Mirepoix (2:1:1 onion, celery, carrot 1/4-inch dice): 8 quarts stored in polycarbonate Cambros, labeled and dated.
- Veal demi-glace reduction: 4 quarts hot-held at 65C in induction warmer well #2.
- Fresh herbs: 1 quart chives sliced brunoise (clean cuts, no bruising), 1 pint picked tarragon leaves in damp paper towel.
- Compound butter: 24 quenelles of shallot-herb butter held in ice bath.
- Pan sauce stock: 6 quarts unsalted chicken stock strained through chinois.
All prep must be completed and inspected by sous chef by 4:30 PM service call.
